large_space_record.message: negctl-dup-switch: the 2^m family is not demonstrated on this board -- the first 60 dips name only 1 distinct cells; duplicates share one latch bit, so 2^60 counts latch masks the level cannot hold. The bound counts each dip in isolation; it is only a bound when the dip sources lie on one switch-free, hazard-free lane, because otherwise walking between two dips latches switches the subset did not choose and the 2^m states are not distinct reachable states.

wellformed_problems: the switch list repeats a cell; `switch_index` collapses duplicates to one latch bit, so any count taken over the list is larger than the number of distinct latch states
